purpose: A fixed, vertically centred badge pinned to the right edge of the viewport. Rendered on EVERY route, and it is the only node that sits OUTSIDE the section.page shell.

href.note: Measured: "#" - inert. The original linked outward; this clone deliberately does not.

artwork.note: A single inline SVG, 53.08 x 171.358, with a .js-color-bg black plate and .js-color-text white lettering. It carries NO text node, so this section has no copy at all.

evidence.structure: Structure, layout and motion measured against the live original. A pixel audit verified 1382/1382 elements at a 1440px viewport and 962/962 at 390px with zero deltas. Copy is the original's own.
evidence.copy: n/a - the badge contains no text node

constraints.verification: src/layout/Layout.jsx:46 renders <AwwwardsBadge /> after the closing </section> of section.page, unconditionally. Checked against all 5 real templates: it is the last node in every one.

motion.detail: No animation at all. position fixed, z-index 999, top 50%, right 0, transform translateY(-50%) - all inline.
motion.reducedMotionFallback: Unchanged - this section has no motion to reduce.
motion.reducedMotionFallbackKind: design-rule (the source ships NO prefers-reduced-motion handling for this section, so the fallback is prescribed by this repository, not mirrored)

responsive.base: fixed to the right edge at 50% height

measuredFrom.quote: in the original this sits OUTSIDE section.page

contentMaxWordsTotalNote: This section has NO text field at all - the badge is a single inline SVG with no text node - so a word total is meaningless. The schema enforces the absence directly by closing `content` to `href` and `artwork`.
